reference.configuration: Original interpretation of the game’s unbuilt Number 13 design study: four twin 18-inch turrets, fore-and-aft superfiring pairs and central machinery. The historical project had multiple design studies; this image does not claim a finalized historical arrangement. Hull proportions and small fittings are illustration choices.
reference.note: Equipment stations follow the existing shared-geometry recognition drawing. Hull and superstructure are simplified into cuboids. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
